blurb: Baby Cobra Yoga offers donation-based yoga classes with no reservations required, providing mats and props free of charge. They have three studio locations in Brooklyn and Manhattan. The studio emphasizes accessibility, community, and a no-frills approach to yoga practice.
extraNote: No reservations; walk-ins only; arrive early to secure spot · Donation suggested based on income, no fixed price for drop-in classes · Deposit for teacher training is non-refundable but can be used for future trainings · Buzz #206 and walk up to the second floor at 47 Thames St, Bushwick location. For 7 PM class, buzz #203.
